name: Chinese tallow
desc: Chinese tallow (Triadica sebifera): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 33 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Triadica sebifera is a tree native to eastern Asia (Chinese 乌桕, wū jiù). It is commonly called Chinese tallow, Chinese tallowtree, Florida aspen, chicken tree, gray popcorn tree, or candleberry tree.
